scenePacket.identityPolicy: stable synthetic identity keyed by causal entity id; never copy a real person's face
scenePacket.culturalPolicy: Panamanian/Cocle visual context is a prior, not a costume rule; no folklore caricature
scenePacket.truthPolicy: appearance can infer texture/style but cannot create, delete, relocate, or write back causal entities

target.temporal: stable identities, geometry and materials across keyframes
target.behavior: people visibly interact with causal narrative, environment, humans and animals
target.materials: photographic skin, fabric, vegetation, soil, water, concrete, wood, metal and glass
target.lighting: natural physically plausible light and shadows derived from world state

runtime.costPolicy: no paid inference without explicit approval
